args.title: Fix 'pickLocale' to account for 'q' values in 'Accept-Language'
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The `pickLocale` function currently ignores the 'q' values in the 'Accept-Language' header, which are used to determine the priority of the preferred languages by quality value. This change will modify the `pickLocale` function to properly parse and consider these 'q' values, ensuring accurate locale selection according to user preferences.
